body:
## Exhibition "Fossils as Reflections of the Past" opened in Žagubica!

The Natural History Museum's exhibition "Fossils as Reflections of the Past" was ceremonially opened at the Homolje Heritage Museum in Žagubica, taking visitors on a journey through millions of years of the history of life on Earth.

This exhibition is part of the rich palaeontological collections of the Natural History Museum, which has preserved the national natural heritage for more than 130 years and, through guest appearances throughout the country, brings it closer to new audiences — especially young people and families.

The cooperation with the Homolje Heritage Museum is of particular value, because exhibitions like this show how important it is for natural history heritage to be accessible across Serbia.

📍 Homolje Heritage Museum, Žagubica 📆 The exhibition is open until the end of August 👣 Walk through millions of years of the past!
